description: GAP-7 (bean qou-6ind, epic qou-xu6t): tests — and REFUTES — the reading of GAP-3's triple Ursell Δ³g as a 4-body coefficient c₄ comparable against μ₄ (or, as the bean framed it, against μ₃'s sign). The residual-simplex moments μ_k are indexed by PARTICLE count via M(A) = Σ_k μ_k C(A,k); the mixed differences Δᵐg are indexed by BOND count. For three particles the bonds 0↔1, 1↔2, 0↔2 form a triangle — three bonds, three vertices — so Δ³g is a 3-BODY object, and no 3-particle measurement constrains μ₄ at any bond order because the C(A,4) column vanishes for A<4 (Lean QOU.MassTheory.UrsellSlotAlignment.mu4_unconstrained_below_four, sorry-free). The correct μ₃ comparand is the assembled moment ΣΔ²g + Δ³g (Lean triangle_moment_decomp), verified here numerically against its direct definition to <1e-20 on both isotopes. Neither shortcut is valid: measured, the omitted terms do not cancel. RESULT: the correction is large (T: 0.4225 → 0.9040 in g-units, ~2.1×) but the three positive pair differences outweigh the negative triple, so the assembled moment keeps their sign — #4404's sign obstruction SURVIVES the slot correction (Lean moment_pos_of_triple_dominated), and the magnitude gap against the derived μ₃=+0.4708 WIDENS from 3.76×/2.99× to 8.04×/7.70×. CORRECTION OF RECORD: the bean's 'c₃ negative / c₄ positive sign alternation' is one 3-body moment split into two pieces read separately, not evidence of a ladder alternation; A=3 data contains no 4-body information. A genuine μ₄ comparand requires A=4 (H₁₂, 6 bonds, 64 subset traces) and is NOT done here. Reuses the GAP-3 kernel unchanged. Scope-(a) negative. No Δ_λ, no μ fitted, nothing wired.

slot_alignment.lean: QOU.MassTheory.UrsellSlotAlignment: triangle_moment_decomp, moment_eq_pair_iff, moment_eq_triple_iff, moment_pos_of_triple_dominated, mu4_unconstrained_below_four
slot_alignment.verdict: Δ³g is a 3-body object, not c₄; the slot correction roughly doubles the magnitude but PRESERVES the sign, so #4404's obstruction survives and the μ₃ gap widens 3.76×/2.99× → 8.04×/7.70×; μ₄ unmeasurable at A=3
